verdict.rationale: Green and Spiegel's own pages present it as a law firm that has spent over 60 years exclusively practicing immigration law and invite clients to connect with an immigration lawyer, so this is not an unsupervised form service. The evidence names no individual attorneys and never states who prepares and signs or files the petition. missing for 10: named licensed attorneys or bar credentials, an explicit attorney-of-record statement for petition preparation and filing, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my petition is prepared and filed by licensed immigration attorneys — named lawyers or a stated attorney-of-record model on the provider's own pages, not an unsupervised form service

citations.quote: With over 60 years of experience exclusively practicing immigration law, Green & Spiegel can assist you with any type of immigration application in Canada or the United States.
Green and Spiegel U.S. is the perfect firm
